fresh_test_policy: Excluded from every fitting and validation partition, including known-state evaluation. Model lists fixed by official hardware availability and architecture membership, not label counts or observed accuracy.
source_shape_policy: A10080GB SXM400W, H100SXM80GB, H200SXM141GB remain separate; no PCIe/SXM pooling or capacity-variant merging.
selection: For each protocol: choose leaf on validation observed-class macro-F1 for each feature set; choose feature set on validation observed-class macro-F1, then validation accuracy, then fewer features. Test scored only after all selections are frozen. Four-class macro-F1 also always reported.

quality_policy.static_core_out_of_training_range: pending; do not stretch training bounds using test hardware
quality_policy.cohort: Same architecture validation models within factor2 for all three core static fields; otherwise at least two numeric-neighbor validation models. Architecture is optional metadata for evidence routing, never RF input.
quality_policy.decision: Each predicted binary sign needs validation support/precision in the related cohort. Missing an unrelated combined class does not reject every GPU. No RF probability threshold or global four-class switch.
quality_policy.limitations: Correlated synthetic states; support and precision are operational checks, not calibrated real-world confidence. No thresholds selected on test results.

omitted_same_architecture_tests: Only two Hopper and two Blackwell models: insufficient distinct model groups for train/validation/test within one architecture.
